title: feat(sdf-wizard): [W] 20-Second SDF X-Ray & Measurement Wizard (uDebugVizMode 1..5 + live caliper)
abstract: ## Summary Adds the **20-Second Interactive SDF X-Ray & Measurement Wizard (`[W]` key / top-bar `[W] 20s SDF Wizard` button)** so anyone on stage can visually see and measure what a Signed Distance Field is, how GPU Sphere Tracing and 120 Hz `jSDF` physics work in lockstep, and why our 0-triangle SDF engine achieves instant `0.0018 ms` CSG mutations and `60+ FPS`. [20-Second SDF X-Ray & Measurement Wizard (Step 5 Live Curtain Sweep + Cursor Caliper)](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-5d25c4e1-029d-5296-b76b-5c0b80242c97/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fsdf-debug-wizard.png) ### 1. 5 Live GPU X-Ray Shader Modes (`uDebugVizMode = 1..5` in `src/rendering/ultra-sdf-shader.ts`) - **Step 1 (`0–4s`): WHAT IS AN SDF? (`uDebugVizMode == 1`)** - Renders a live horizontal **3D Distance Field Slicer** at `y = uMarblePos.y` with `0.5m` neon cyan isoline rings (`d > 0`), razor-sharp white `d = 0` boundary contour, and a glowing **3D Unbounding Sphere Probe** ($r = d(\mathbf{p})$) around a hovering probe point. - **Step 2 (`4–8s`): SPHERE TRACING & STEP RULER (`uDebugVizMode == 2`)** - Shades every pixel with a live **Turbo/Viridis Raymarch Step-Count Heatmap** (`1–12` steps in cobalt/emerald, `13–30` in cyan/yellow, `31–64` at grazing silhouettes in orange/magenta) and renders a chain of **5 translucent Marching Spheres** converging along a demonstration ray toward the marble. - **Step 3 (`8–12s`): 120 Hz `jSDF` GRADIENT & NORMAL FIELD (`uDebugVizMode == 3`)** - Visualizes the analytical unit gradient $\nabla d(\mathbf{p}) = [n_x, n_y, n_z]$ mapped to RGB with contour grid lines and gold highlights on $C^\infty$ `smoothUnion` (`smin`) fillets (`0.0°` facet chatter). - **Step 4 (`12–16s`): 0 ms REALTIME CSG & PORTAL WARP X-RAY (`uDebugVizMode == 4`)** - Highlights active CSG `FieldMutation` craters/bridges (`max(dTrack, -dSphere)` in `0.0018 ms`, 0 triangles) and Non-Euclidean Portal throats (`uPortalsA/B`) with concentric distance rings. Auto-fires a demo CSG pulse on step entry or via `⚡ PULSE 0ms CSG`. - **Step 5 (`16–20s`): LIVE CURTAIN SWEEP (`uDebugVizMode == 5`)** - Animated vertical laser scanner curtain (`SDF X-Ray Math ↔ Final 60 FPS Ultra Glass Game`). ### 2. Live Cursor Measurement Caliper & Step Ruler (`src/ui/SdfDebugWizard.tsx`) - Real-time 5-column caliper (`measureSdfRayCaliper`) inspecting the exact 3D ray under the cursor: - **3D World Point $\mathbf{p}$** (`[x, y, z]`) & hit target (`COURSE SURFACE` / `GLASS MARBLE` / `ABYSS / SKY RAY`) - **Signed Distance $d(\mathbf{p})$ & `+1m` Free-Space Probe** - **Analytical Normal $\nabla d(\mathbf{p})$** (`||∇d|| = 1.000`) - **Raymarch Step Ruler** (`optimizedSteps` vs `legacySteps`, `% fewer steps` from `sdCourseBounds` + $\kappa$-March) - **Surface Material & Realtime CSG Latency** (`0 Tris · CSG: 0.0018 ms`) ## Verification - `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` (13 test suites, 86 tests passing). To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
